Subject: Re: Offer setup question — comp band / approval steps for Sam Cho

Thanks Jasmine — got it. Short answers:
- The role is hiring manager approval up to band midpoint + 5%. Anything above midpoint +5% requires TA Lead (Lauren) + Comp Review (Mina).
- For IC3 to go to midpoint +8% we need Director approval; for any sign-on > 10% of base we need Finance notification (rare).
- Equity: target grant is $40k over 4 years as you noted; if you want to add a one-time retention grant, loop Mina for comp policy.

Please draft two Greenhouse offer templates:
A) Standard: $180k base, 10% bonus, $40k equity. Route: HM approval -> Recruiter finalize -> candidate.
B) Elevated: $194k base (midpoint +8%), 10% bonus, $40k equity + 6-month retention cash (one-time). Route: HM -> Lauren (TA Lead) -> Mina (Comp) -> Director (if Mina approves) -> Recruiter finalize.

If the candidate has competing offers, flag "expedite approvals" and I'll personally escalate.

On the equity language: please use the standard RSU vesting clause we use in GH offers.

-Rohan
